purpose: Canonical secret-free roster for MCP-connected agents, service surfaces, tool scopes, and Operation BB readiness.
rules: No raw secret, token, cookie, private key, JWT value, password, or provider credential belongs in this file.
Prefer public read-only endpoints first; use authenticated full MCP only for named agents with a bounded tool allowlist.
No free shell, docker.sock, root action, production deploy, broad Neo4j write, or worker start should be exposed to external agents by default.
Container routing is exposed as read-only status: runtime Docker Desktop, atelier Podman, registry Docker Hub, prod Hetzner. Raw docker.sock and unscoped stop/delete/prune/build remain blocked.
Canonical private MCP URL is https://mcp.funesterie.me/mcp. The /kiro/mcp path is legacy and should not be used for new Kiro/Codex shared MCP configs.
All write-like actions must be scoped, audited, and reversible or append-only.

public_grok.notes: Grok-safe reduced tool surface. Prefer future Cloudflare proxy with X-Agent-Id for stronger gating.

private_full.notes: Full MCP endpoint. Client configs must reference env vars or OAuth, never inline bearer values.

local_a11_kiro.notes: Kiro local MCP for A11 route map, identity, and local diagnostics.

blocked_by_default: direct docker/podman stop/delete/prune/build without explicit human scope
